name: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
description: Demonstrates fluency with core prompting techniques: zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought reasoning, and persona-based system prompts. Can apply these patterns to real workplace tasks in ChatGPT and Claude.

name: Advanced Prompt Patterns & AI Workflows
description: Demonstrates mastery of advanced prompting architectures — ReAct, Tree of Thought, meta-prompts — and the ability to chain AI tools together into automated workflows with responsible evaluation practices.

name: No-Code Automation Builder
description: Can design and build multi-step automations in Zapier and Make.com, apply filters and error handling, and integrate n8n for open-source self-hosted workflows.

name: AI-Powered Workflow Integrations
description: Demonstrates ability to embed AI steps (OpenAI and Claude) into no-code automations, connect business tools like Slack, Notion, and Google Sheets, and ship monitored end-to-end workflows.

name: LLM APIs & LangChain Fundamentals
description: Can call OpenAI and Anthropic APIs from Python, build LangChain chains with prompt templates and memory, and load and split documents for downstream embedding.

name: Vector Databases & RAG Pipelines
description: Demonstrates the ability to generate and store embeddings in FAISS or Chroma, build a complete retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, and deploy it as an interactive Streamlit application with LangSmith tracing.
